products.name: Fiddler AI
products.note: Model performance management; explainability; bias detection; drift monitoring; LLM observability

profile_text.body:
Fiddler is an enterprise AI governance and observability company whose platform it describes as an "AI Control Plane" intended to give organizations visibility, control, and trust over both agentic and predictive AI deployments. The company positions its product for software and AI engineers, data scientists, platform and DevOps teams, and security and compliance teams, with a particular focus on regulated industries including financial services, healthcare, insurance, and government. The platform covers continuous evaluation, monitoring, policy enforcement, and auditable governance across first-party and third-party agents from creation through production.

The core product, Fiddler AI, includes capabilities for model performance management, explainability, bias detection, drift monitoring, and LLM observability. A featured component called Fiddler Centor Models runs within a customer's own environment to power guardrails and evaluations without external LLM API calls, which the company claims reduces evaluation total cost of ownership by up to 98% compared to foundation models. The platform also detects and redacts PII, PHI, and secrets before prompts reach a model or responses reach a developer, and records enforcement decisions for audit purposes. Fiddler describes itself as model- and cloud-agnostic, citing compatibility with Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, LangGraph, and over 100 other providers.

The site's held facts confirm Fiddler maintains a tracked product under the AI Governance and Risk Management Platforms category. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the available data.
